route_title: Quarter-Wave Initialized 12L with Weighted Center Wavelength
compilation_rationale: Resolved 12 alternating Ta2O5/SiO2 layers on Si. Initialized quarter-wave thicknesses at 1380 nm (~165 nm and ~238 nm), projected above the 80 nm floor. Applied 0.5x learning-rate scaling. Targets minimize mean reflectance over both specified NIR bands using coherent TMM under normal-unpolarized illumination.
